videoDetails.title: Overtures Roundtable Discussion Part 3
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Join Derek Radney, Steve Tipton, David Coffin, and Howie Donahoe for a roundtable discussion exploring the overtures and key questions facing the PCA ahead of the 2026 General Assembly. In Part 3, the panel discusses the judicial, administrative, and polity overtures under consideration this year.

Overtures Discussion Part 1: https://youtu.be/xezEYJN8aiM
Overtures Discussion Part 2: https://youtu.be/JpsstSfx40U
